=== 6250ed716 ===
picard: the W2 converse and the window-coordinate cancellation

Two bricks the class side of the backward classification needs and the tree did
not have:

* map_pairTautFst/Snd_eq_of_specMap_pairChartMap_eq -- the exact converse of the
  landed specMap_pairChartMap_eq_of_map_pairTaut_eq: two pair-chart maps that
  present the SAME morphism to grPair pull the tautological pair back equally.
  It is the pairTaut reading of the two chart-compatibility theorems of
  DivCarvePairChart, which had never been stated in the spelling the divisor
  frames use.
* submodule_eq_of_map_baseChange_equivFun_eq -- base change of a basis
  coordinate equivalence stays injective, so Submodule.map along it reflects
  equality: this is what removes the coordinates from a frame identity.

Plus span_range_mul_eq_top: the product of two span-top families is span-top,
i.e. two finite affine covers of Spec S have a common refinement by basic opens.

picard: the class side of the backward classification -- separation

eq_of_isDivRepClassify: two locally certified divisor classes over an affine
test that are classified by the SAME morphism are EQUAL.  With the landed
isDivRepClassify_unique (the hom side) the characterizing clause is now a
bijective correspondence on the nose, and divRepClassifyZar is injective.

This is the first advance on the divRep mountain that is certificate-free AND
free of the DDR9-U epsilon-identity U2 -- which exists in no Lean declaration at
any level, and which the roadmap records as the gate of pull_classify.  Nothing
here mentions a universal family.

The route, at each carrier of the product of the two classes' certificate x
frame covers:
  the clause fires at each class's own away carrier; both chart presentations of
  v push along the structure maps to the common refinement, so they present the
  SAME morphism Spec B -> grPair; the W2 converse turns that into equality of the
  pulled tautological pairs; map_window_frame_toSubmodule reads each side as the
  coordinate image of the restricted epsilon; the coordinates cancel; and
  divFam_divEq_of_eps_eq_total (DDR-8, seam-free, any test ring, only hO/hchi)
  concludes.  DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq globalizes.

Deliberately NOT used: eq_of_divFamEps_eq (field-only, and gated on the open DD-4
sections dictionary Phi) and divFam_divEq_of_eps_eq (its hbridge seam is a
disguised hypothesis whose sketched route is false, I-0231).

picard: the datum-level Abel-Jacobi map and its pointing law

The top of the mountain, where nobody had worked.  Two of the fifteen frozen
Challenge.lean sorries now have datum-level avatars that are PROVED, not
sketched -- they become one-liners the moment DAT-J produces jacobianData,
because Jacobian C := (jacobianData C).J definitionally:

  JacobianData.ofCurve d P : C -> d.J  :=  d.homEquiv.symm (abelElement C P)
      the frozen Jacobian.ofCurve (Challenge.lean:125)
  JacobianData.comp_ofCurve : P >> d.ofCurve P = eta[d.J]
      the frozen Jacobian.comp_ofCurve (Challenge.lean:130)

The map was already in use UNNAMED at JacobianDataBaseChangeAbel.lean:115/:151;
naming it costs nothing and turns the gate into "exact (jacobianData C).ofCurve P".

The pointing law is NOT free, and the load-bearing step is homEquiv_one:
eta[d.J] is MonObj.one of GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy, which mathlib defines as
"alpha.homEquiv'.symm 1", and RepresentableBy.homEquiv' (ConcreteCategory/
Representable.lean:29) IS homEquiv -- so the two cancel and the kernel confirms
the defeq.  With that, homEquiv-injectivity + the naturality square homEquiv_comp
+ the landed abelElement_map_point close it.

Rooted in AlgebraicJacobian.lean before JacobianDataBaseChange; full default
build green (9081 jobs); axioms exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

NOT addressed: exists_unique_ofCurve_comp (Challenge.lean:141), the Albanese
universal property, which has no avatar anywhere in the tree.

=== e47d57de1 ===
picard: chartLocus exists -- the class-indexed chart locus and its openness (C9a)

Until this commit `chartLocus` had ZERO code hits tree-wide: eight occurrences,
all in doc comments, one of which (Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:20) calls it
"the still-undefined chartLocus".  Four roadmap comments under dat-c call the
remainder of C9 "plumbing, no math left" -- an assessment that had never been
tested because the gate itself did not exist.

Defined now, at the carrier level the consumers need, and with its keystone
proved:

  chartLocus pi c : Set (PrimeSpectrum B)
    := {q | every basic-open cocycle datum with fibre class c has an effective
            witness divisor with vanishing H^1 at kappa(q)}
  mem_chartLocus_iff_of_datum -- any ONE presenting datum is a sound and
    complete test (class-intrinsicity, hasWitnessH1Vanishing_congr_of_cechPicClass_eq)
  mem_chartLocus_iff_exists   -- the forall-form and the exists-form agree
    (every class is presented, BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq)
  isOpen_chartLocus           -- OPENNESS

The design decision the roadmap asked for is taken and recorded: chartLocus is a
locus in the PARAMETER space Spec B indexed by a Picard CLASS, not a predicate on
a chosen datum.  That distinction is the whole content -- the landed openness
engine (isOpen_setOf_exists_witness_h1_vanishing) is stated for a chosen D, and a
chart indexed by a class may not depend on a presentation.  The two are reconciled
by the fibre-field/class-intrinsicity layer, which was landed and unused.

Certificate-free and divRep-free: no DivFamZar, no IsCertified, no
RepresentableBy datum appears anywhere in the cone of these four declarations.
Rooted in AlgebraicJacobian.lean; full default build green (9082 jobs); axioms
exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

NOT here: the C9 deliverable f_c (the chart morphism), which genuinely needs a
universal family and stays gated on divRep/CERT-Sigma.

DivRepAffinePullback (DivRepAffKit.lean:169) is the exact output F5 owes before

    a class classified by v, then it inverts the backward classifier.  Both
    pull (classify F) and F satisfy the characterizing clause for the single
    morphism classify F, so eq_of_isDivRepClassify identifies them.
  DivRepAffinePullback.ofPull -- the three-field constructor.  A producer now owes
    pull, the clause law, and naturality; the round-trip law is derived.

Of the four original obligations the roadmap's audit found exactly one
(pull_naturality) provable from inputs that exist today, and two gated on the
DDR9-U epsilon-identity U2, which exists in NO Lean declaration at any level.
This retires the fourth WITHOUT U2, so the U2-gated remainder is now two fields,
not three.  There is still no producer of a DivRepAffinePullback; this reduces
what one costs.

/-- **The composite certificate × frame cover on canonical carriers**
(w4-ddr9 §2.1 steps 1–2, assembled): a finite span-⊤ family `r : Fin m → S` such
that over each canonical `Localization.Away (r p)` some certified representative of
the restricted class is framed by a pair chart — certificate cover × per-piece frame
covers × the numerator trick, pieces by `exists_certChart_piece`. -/
theorem DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (r : Fin m → S), Ideal.span (Set.range r) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ p : Fin m,
        ∃ (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away (r p)) π g)
          (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
          (w : PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j →ₐ[k] Localization.Away (r p)),
          (DivFam.mk G).toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (r p)) g F₀ ∧
          (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
            = Submodule.map
                (LinearMap.baseChange (Localization.Away (r p))
                  b₁.equivFun.toLinearMap)
                (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).1 ∧
          (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
            = Submodule.map
                (LinearMap.baseChange (Localization.Away (r p))
                  b₂.equivFun.toLinearMap)
                (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).2 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨mc, h, hspanH, hGl⟩ := DivFamZar.exists_certified_away_rep F₀
  choose Gl hZl using hGl
  have hFC := fun l : Fin mc =>
    divFamEps_exists_frameCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ (DivFam.mk (Gl l))
  choose mf f hspanF hframe using hFC
  choose ci cj cw hcw₁ hcw₂ using hframe
  have hassoc : ∀ (l : Fin mc) (t : Fin (mf l)),
      Associated (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (h l))
        ((IsLocalization.Away.sec (h l) (f l t)).1)) (f l t) :=
    fun l t => IsLocalization.Away.associated_sec_fst (h l) (f l t)
  -- the composite span-⊤ family, `ULift`ed into the working universe
  have hspanH' : Ideal.span
      (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc) => h l.down) = ⊤ := by
    have hrange : (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc) => h l.down)
        = Set.range h := ULift.down_surjective.range_comp h
    rw [hrange, hspanH]
  have hr : Ideal.span (Set.range
      fun p : Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down) =>
        (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h p.1.down) (f p.1.down p.2)).1 * h p.1.down)
      = ⊤ :=
    span_range_num_mul_eq_top (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc) => h l.down)
      (fun l => Localization.Away (h l.down)) hspanH'
      (fun l => f l.down) (fun l => hspanF l.down)
      (fun l t => (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h l.down) (f l.down t)).1)
      (fun l t => hassoc l.down t)
  -- reindex the sigma family by `Fin`
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card (Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down)))
      ≃ Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down) :=
    (Fintype.equivFin (Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down))).symm
  refine ⟨Fintype.card (Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down)),
    fun q => (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h (e q).1.down) (f (e q).1.down (e q).2)).1
      * h (e q).1.down, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hrange : (Set.range fun q =>
        (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h (e q).1.down) (f (e q).1.down (e q).2)).1
          * h (e q).1.down)
        = Set.range (fun p : Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down) =>
            (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h p.1.down) (f p.1.down p.2)).1
              * h p.1.down) :=
      e.surjective.range_comp
        (fun p : Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down) =>
          (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h p.1.down) (f p.1.down p.2)).1 * h p.1.down)
    rw [hrange, hr]
  · intro q
    exact exists_certChart_piece hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ (h (e q).1.down)
      (Gl (e q).1.down) (hZl (e q).1.down) (f (e q).1.down (e q).2)
      ((IsLocalization.Away.sec (h (e q).1.down) (f (e q).1.down (e q).2)).1)
      (hassoc (e q).1.down (e q).2)
      (cw (e q).1.down (e q).2) (hcw₁ (e q).1.down (e q).2)
      (hcw₂ (e q).1.down (e q).2)

/-! ## The locally certified divisor-functor value -/

variable (C R π)
variable (n : ℕ)

/-- The divisor-equality setoid on locally certified systems (Addendum 2's mirror of
`divFamSetoid`): the underlying local-equation systems cut the same divisor; the local
certificates are per-representative data and do not enter the relation. -/
def divFamZarSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} where
  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
  iseqv :=
    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩

/-- **The locally certified divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`**
(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): locally certified local-equation systems of
degree `n` up to divisor equality. This is the carrier on which the divisor functor is
a Zariski sheaf — the globally certified `DivFam` remains the building block. -/
def DivFamZar : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarSetoid C R π n)

namespace DivFamZar

variable {C R π n}

/-- The class of a locally certified system. -/
def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :
    DivFamZar C R π n :=
  Quotient.mk (divFamZarSetoid C R π n) ⟨d, hd⟩

lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₂} :
    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
  Quotient.eq (r := divFamZarSetoid C R π n)

/-- **The Picard class of a locally certified divisor class** `𝒪(D)`: well defined on
the quotient by `picClass_eq_of_divEq`. -/
noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFamZar C R π n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
  Quotient.lift
    (fun d : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} =>
      d.1.picClass)
    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F

@[simp]

9	/-!
10	# F5 — the class side of the backward classification: separation
11	
12	`Picard/DivRepClassifyZar.lean` proves the *hom* side of the backward classification:
13	a locally certified divisor class determines a **unique** morphism satisfying the
14	characterizing clause (`isDivRepClassify_unique`).  This file proves the *class* side:
15	a morphism satisfying the clause determines the **class**.
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.map_pairTautFst_eq_of_specMap_pairChartMap_eq` and its `Snd`
18	  mirror — **the W2 converse**: two pair-chart maps presenting the same morphism to
19	  `grPair` pull the tautological pair back equally.  The forward implication is
20	  `specMap_pairChartMap_eq_of_map_pairTaut_eq`
21	  (`Picard/GrassmannianPairCompare.lean`); the converse is the two chart-compatibility
22	  theorems of `Picard/DivCarvePairChart.lean` read in the `pairTaut` spelling.
23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.eq_of_isDivRepClassify` — **the separation theorem**: two locally
24	  certified divisor classes over an affine test whose classifying morphism is the same
25	  are equal.
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepClassifyZar_injective` — the packaged corollary.

29	composite certificate × frame cover (`DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover`), the frame
30	transport `map_window_frame_toSubmodule`, the seam-free relative mono
31	`divFam_divEq_of_eps_eq_total` (DDR-8), and Zariski separation for `DivFamZar`

97	/-- **The coordinate embedding of a window is injective**: base change of a linear
98	equivalence along `k → B` is an equivalence, so `Submodule.map` along it reflects
99	equality.  This is what removes the `b.equivFun` coordinates from a frame identity. -/
100	theorem submodule_eq_of_map_baseChange_equivFun_eq
101	    {k : Type u} [Field k] {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] {r : ℕ}
102	    (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) k M) (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
103	    {P Q : Submodule B (TensorProduct k B M)}
104	    (h : Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.toLinearMap) P
105	       = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.toLinearMap) Q) :
106	    P = Q := by
107	  have hcomp : (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.symm.toLinearMap).comp
108	      (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.toLinearMap) = LinearMap.id := by
109	    rw [← LinearMap.baseChange_comp]
110	    simp
111	  have hinj : Function.Injective (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.toLinearMap) := by
112	    intro x y hxy
113	    have h1 := congrArg (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.symm.toLinearMap) hxy
114	    have h2 : (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.symm.toLinearMap).comp
115	        (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.toLinearMap) x
116	      = (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.symm.toLinearMap).comp
117	        (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.toLinearMap) y := h1
118	    rwa [hcomp, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at h2
119	  exact Submodule.map_injective_of_injective hinj h
120	
121	end WindowCancel

# CHART-U(b) — datum-level openness of the chart-membership (witness) locus
(`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md` §1.6, `informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` §3.3)

The affine-level heart of the shared CHART-U(b) brick, stated directly on a pinned
basic-open cocycle datum in the **witness form** the `chartLocus` predicate uses.

For a datum `D` over an affine base `B`, the locus of primes `q` of `B` at which the
fibre class of `D` at `κ(q)` admits an effective witness divisor with vanishing `H¹`
is Zariski-open in `Spec B`.  This is the single sanctioned openness mechanism of the
campaign (`datumRigidEngine_isOpen_vanishing`, Noetherian-free — dat-d §3.5) read
through the two-way datum dictionary of C1
(`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness`,
`informal/w4-datc-worksheet.md` GAP-6): the engine open is the complex-form fibre
condition `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗[B] κ(q))`, and the dictionary rewrites it,
pointwise and class-intrinsically, as the effective-witness/h¹-vanishing condition.

Role in the CHART-U(b) chain (the two unlanded links of §5 risk 1):

* **the shifted-datum constructor (link 1):** over the étale carrier `B` the plus
  class collapses to an honest Čech class; twisted by the theta layer and DAT-C's
  GAP-1 inverse datum into the `λθᵐ(Σ-shift)⁻¹` class, then extracted
  (`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_cechPicClass_eq`) to a datum `D`.  The output of
  that link is exactly a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` — the input of the theorem
  below, whose witness set is then the `chartLocus`-over-`B`.
* **the étale-image openness transport (link 2):** the locus over the test base `A`
  is the image, under the (open, surjective) étale carrier map `Spec B → Spec A`, of
  the open locus this theorem produces — carried to `A` by mathlib's
  `IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap`/`IsQuotientMap.isOpen_preimage` once the fibre-field
  invariance identifies the preimage.

The theorem is class-intrinsic (any datum in the class has the same witness set, by
(V1a)), so a change of extracted representative is free.
-/

/-! ## The locally certified divisor-functor value -/

variable (C R π)
variable (n : ℕ)

/-- The divisor-equality setoid on locally certified systems (Addendum 2's mirror of
`divFamSetoid`): the underlying local-equation systems cut the same divisor; the local
certificates are per-representative data and do not enter the relation. -/
def divFamZarSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} where
  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
  iseqv :=
    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩

/-- **The locally certified divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`**
(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): locally certified local-equation systems of
degree `n` up to divisor equality. This is the carrier on which the divisor functor is
a Zariski sheaf — the globally certified `DivFam` remains the building block. -/
def DivFamZar : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarSetoid C R π n)

namespace DivFamZar

variable {C R π n}

/-- The class of a locally certified system. -/
def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :
    DivFamZar C R π n :=
  Quotient.mk (divFamZarSetoid C R π n) ⟨d, hd⟩

lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d₂} :
    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
  Quotient.eq (r := divFamZarSetoid C R π n)

/-- **The Picard class of a locally certified divisor class** `𝒪(D)`: well defined on
the quotient by `picClass_eq_of_divEq`. -/
noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFamZar C R π n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
  Quotient.lift
    (fun d : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} =>
      d.1.picClass)
    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F

@[simp]
lemma picClass_mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)

/-- **The W3 left-leg pushforward** (w4-ddr9 §2.1 step 4, single window): a coordinate
Grassmannian point over `T` whose submodule is the boundary-basis image of the
restricted ε window maps, along a structure-compatible `β : T →ₐ[k] B`, to the point
framing the `B`-restricted window.  Identify with `congrAmbient` of the packaged point
(`Module.Grassmannian.ext`), then K4 (`map_congrAmbient`) + the tower transport. -/
theorem map_window_frame_toSubmodule {r : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) k
      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))
    (F : DivFam C S π g) (β : T →ₐ[k] B)
    (hβ : β.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap S T) = algebraMap S B)
    (y : Grassmannian.grFunctorAff k (Fin r → k) g T)
    (hy : y.toSubmodule = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange T b.equivFun.toLinearMap)
        ((DivFam.mapAlg T g F).window ha1)) :
    (Module.Grassmannian.map β y).toSubmodule
      = Submodule.map (LinearMap.baseChange B b.equivFun.toLinearMap)
          ((DivFam.mapAlg B g F).window ha1) := by
  have hyeq : y = congrAmbient b.equivFun (divFamWindowGr hπ g hO hχ a ha1 hMa F T) := by
    refine Module.Grassmannian.ext ?_
    rw [hy, congrAmbient_toSubmodule, divFamWindowGr_toSubmodule,
      ← DivFam.window_mapAlg hπ g hO hχ a ha1 hMa T F]
  rw [hyeq, map_congrAmbient β b.equivFun (divFamWindowGr hπ g hO hχ a ha1 hMa F T),
    map_divFamWindowGr_algHom hπ g hO hχ a ha1 hMa F β hβ,
    congrAmbient_toSubmodule, divFamWindowGr_toSubmodule,
    ← DivFam.window_mapAlg hπ g hO hχ a ha1 hMa B F]

end WindowTransport

/-- **The composite certificate × frame cover on canonical carriers**
(w4-ddr9 §2.1 steps 1–2, assembled): a finite span-⊤ family `r : Fin m → S` such
that over each canonical `Localization.Away (r p)` some certified representative of
the restricted class is framed by a pair chart — certificate cover × per-piece frame
covers × the numerator trick, pieces by `exists_certChart_piece`. -/
theorem DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover (F₀ : DivFamZar C S π g) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (r : Fin m → S), Ideal.span (Set.range r) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ p : Fin m,
        ∃ (G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away (r p)) π g)
          (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
          (w : PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j →ₐ[k] Localization.Away (r p)),
          (DivFam.mk G).toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg (Localization.Away (r p)) g F₀ ∧
          (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautFst k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
            = Submodule.map
                (LinearMap.baseChange (Localization.Away (r p))
                  b₁.equivFun.toLinearMap)
                (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).1 ∧
          (Module.Grassmannian.map w (pairTautSnd k g r₁ r₂ i j)).toSubmodule
            = Submodule.map
                (LinearMap.baseChange (Localization.Away (r p))
                  b₂.equivFun.toLinearMap)
                (divFamEps hπ g (DivFam.mk G)).2 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨mc, h, hspanH, hGl⟩ := DivFamZar.exists_certified_away_rep F₀
  choose Gl hZl using hGl
  have hFC := fun l : Fin mc =>
    divFamEps_exists_frameCover hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ (DivFam.mk (Gl l))
  choose mf f hspanF hframe using hFC
  choose ci cj cw hcw₁ hcw₂ using hframe
  have hassoc : ∀ (l : Fin mc) (t : Fin (mf l)),
      Associated (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (h l))
        ((IsLocalization.Away.sec (h l) (f l t)).1)) (f l t) :=
    fun l t => IsLocalization.Away.associated_sec_fst (h l) (f l t)
  -- the composite span-⊤ family, `ULift`ed into the working universe
  have hspanH' : Ideal.span
      (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc) => h l.down) = ⊤ := by
    have hrange : (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc) => h l.down)
        = Set.range h := ULift.down_surjective.range_comp h
    rw [hrange, hspanH]
  have hr : Ideal.span (Set.range
      fun p : Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down) =>
        (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h p.1.down) (f p.1.down p.2)).1 * h p.1.down)
      = ⊤ :=
    span_range_num_mul_eq_top (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc) => h l.down)
      (fun l => Localization.Away (h l.down)) hspanH'
      (fun l => f l.down) (fun l => hspanF l.down)
      (fun l t => (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h l.down) (f l.down t)).1)
      (fun l t => hassoc l.down t)
  -- reindex the sigma family by `Fin`
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card (Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down)))
      ≃ Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down) :=
    (Fintype.equivFin (Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down))).symm
  refine ⟨Fintype.card (Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down)),
    fun q => (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h (e q).1.down) (f (e q).1.down (e q).2)).1
      * h (e q).1.down, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hrange : (Set.range fun q =>
        (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h (e q).1.down) (f (e q).1.down (e q).2)).1
          * h (e q).1.down)
        = Set.range (fun p : Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down) =>
            (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h p.1.down) (f p.1.down p.2)).1
              * h p.1.down) :=
      e.surjective.range_comp
        (fun p : Σ l : ULift.{u} (Fin mc), Fin (mf l.down) =>
          (IsLocalization.Away.sec (h p.1.down) (f p.1.down p.2)).1 * h p.1.down)
    rw [hrange, hr]
  · intro q
    exact exists_certChart_piece hπ g hO hχ r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ F₀ (h (e q).1.down)
      (Gl (e q).1.down) (hZl (e q).1.down) (f (e q).1.down (e q).2)
      ((IsLocalization.Away.sec (h (e q).1.down) (f (e q).1.down (e q).2)).1)
      (hassoc (e q).1.down (e q).2)
      (cw (e q).1.down (e q).2) (hcw₁ (e q).1.down (e q).2)
      (hcw₂ (e q).1.down (e q).2)

end Curve
